card.name: Inside split-up drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of drug or medical words that are broken into several parts, such as the 'og' in clopidogrel or 'il' in a drug ending in -pril. It fires after a short opening fragment like 'pr', 'l' or 'pid'.

modes.label: Drug name middles
modes.description: A short middle piece inside a drug name split into several parts.
modes.example: pid<<og>>rel is metabolized to its active metabol

modes.label: Medical term middles
modes.description: A middle piece inside a longer medical term or condition name.
modes.example: tro<<v>>iral treatment, patients whose immune system responds

card.plain: It marks the middle of a drug name that the model has to read in pieces.
